title: Teutonic Order chiffre book: 'Chiffrenbuch des Dietrich v. Schoenberg u. der hochmeisterlichen Kanzlei' (undated), and the Ducal Prussia Chiffrenbuch 1538-55
shelfmark: GStA PK, XX. HA, OBA, Nr. 27584; XX. HA, EM, 19 a, Nr. 68 (Chiffrenbuch 1538-1555)
note: OBA 27584 is the chancery's own key book: the key for the Schoenberg-Albrecht letters (catalogue 553; this sweep's OBA row). EM 19 a Nr. 68 is the 1538-55 Ducal Prussia book; Nr. 66, 67, 69, 70 were listed in the reachable-unlooked key_leads.

title: Prussian foreign-service ciphers 1735-1798 (keys and cipher notes): Rep. 81 Warschau Ges. I Nr. 1 (1765-91), Rep. 81 Koeln Nr. 1 (Rohd, 1737-46), Rep. 41 Nr. 141 (1745, Chiffriersystem Siepmann to Unruh at Danzig), Rep. 63 Nr. 1472 (1758, Chiffriersystem for the royal cabinet), Rep. 11 Nr. 10135 (Chambrier d'Oleires, 1779-1805), Rep. 81 Vatikan Nr. 294 (1787, 'Chiffre chiffrant et dechiffrant'), Rep. 81 Rastatt Nr. 4 and Nr. 18 (1797-98)
note: Key-only items for the Frederick II to Frederick William II era; the Dresden cabinet orders (candidates row 1) and Frankfurt orders (1809-13) are the ciphertext they would open. Rep. 63 Nr. 1472 and Rep. 41 Nr. 141 are the best match for the 1745-58 Dresden/Dessau ciphers.
